name: Waiting List Applications for Midtown Core Zone Vending License
description:
This dataset lists applications to a waiting list for Midtown Core Zone vending licenses, with 439 sampled records and 12 fields. Each row represents one waitlist application, identified by a waitlist application ID, and includes the applicant's name, a blue waitlist number, and the application's status (Closed, Pending - Blue Waitlist, or Selected from Waitlist). All sampled records fall under the "Blue Waitlist" category.

The data also links each application to a general vendor license, showing the license number, whether it is Active or Inactive, and its type (most commonly Citywide Specialized Vendor, followed by Midtown Specialized Vendor and a small number of General Vendor licenses). A selection date is recorded for about 10% of rows, indicating when an applicant was chosen from the waitlist. Applicant location is captured through city, state, and ZIP code, though roughly 10% of rows lack these details and some ZIP values appear malformed.
